title: Everything you need to know about Googlebooks

claims.claim: Google and its hardware partners officially launched Googlebooks earlier this month.

evidence.quote: Google and its hardware partners officially launched Googlebooks earlier this month with the promise of tight integration between your Android phone and this new, Android-powered laptop OS, plenty of AI-powered tricks and premium hardware.

claims.claim: ASUS Googlebook 14 costs $1,299, weighs 2.2 pounds, features an Intel Core Ultra 5 chip, 16GB of RAM, and 512GB of storage.

evidence.quote: Most of my testing was done on the $1,299 ASUS Googlebook 14, an extremely thin and light laptop that weighs in at only 2.2 pounds. It features an OLED touchscreen with Corning's Gorilla Matte glass, which significantly cuts down on reflections. From a specs standpoint, it runs on an Intel Core Ultra 5 chip with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage.

claims.claim: Acer's Googlebook 14 starts at $899 as the only Googlebook under $1,000.

evidence.quote: The least expensive Googlebook out there, Acer's Googlebook 14, starts at $899 — and that's the only Googlebook under $1,000.

claims.claim: HP's Googlebook 14 runs on the Snapdragon X Elite X1E-80-100 processor.

evidence.quote: I also did some testing on the Acer Googlebook 14 and HP's Googlebook 14, the latter of which runs on the Snapdragon X Elite X1E-80-100 processor.

claims.claim: Googlebooks come with a year of GeForce Now Fast Pass access providing up to 50 hours of gaming per month.
